Subject: Intro + demo: Redwood inference for Rally Retreat

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the intro on the call last week. I'd like to schedule a 45-minute demo to walk through how Redwood can reduce inference costs for your personalization pipeline and show a short pilot plan.

Are you available Tuesday, Nov 17 at 10:00 AM PT or Wednesday, Nov 18 at 2:00 PM PT? I can also do late afternoons if that works better with your travel.

I'll bring Marissa (solutions engineer) to run through the technical deep-dive. Attached is a quick agenda and some slides for context.

Agenda (high level):
- 10m: goals & success criteria
- 20m: demo (latency/throughput examples + routing rules)
- 10m: pilot plan & next steps

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
